title: Your SIM Will Be Blocked
intro: A caller from "the cyber police" says your SIM was misused and will be blocked in two hours.
This time you can talk back. Pick your replies and sniff each message as it arrives.
Every chat ends with your choice. Choose wisely.

notify.text: Your SIM will be blocked in 2 hours

msg: To keep it active, press 1 or text your

replies.text: I did not do anything. Please do not block it.
I will call my phone company myself
OK, paying and sharing the code
A fee and a code for a "verification"? I will call my phone company.

msg: . Now your account will be checked:

msg.text: send the code your bank texts you

replies.text: I will call my phone company

num.label: An unknown number
num.lens: A stranger claiming to be police.
num.why: Real police do not start with an unknown text.

misuse.label: A "misuse" story
misuse.lens: They say your SIM was used for illegal calls, with no proof.
misuse.why: A frightening story with no proof.

idno.label: Asks for your ID details
idno.lens: They want your ID details by text.
idno.why: Never send ID details to a number that contacted you.

pay.label: A fee to avoid blocking
pay.why: No honest office charges to keep a SIM active by phone.

otp.label: Asks for the code
otp.lens: They want the code sent to you.
otp.why: A code is a key to your account. Never share it.

done.label: "Your SIM is safe"
done.why: Reassurance after a threat is a trick.

bank.label: "Send your bank code"
bank.lens: Now they ask for your bank code.
bank.why: The bank code is the real prize.

actions.label: Call my phone company on the number on my bill
Block the number and report it to your local fraud-reporting service

block_report.line: You blocked and reported it. The number was traced and blocked.

verify.line: Your phone company said: nothing is wrong with your SIM, and they never block lines through such texts. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The code gave them your account. It was emptied within minutes, and your SIM was never in danger.

what_if.go_ahead: Calling your phone company on the number on your bill would have shown the SIM was fine.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting the number as well protects others.

golden_rule: A call or text that threatens to block your SIM and asks for money, ID or a code is a scam. Check with your company on the number on your bill.

quick_check.q: A "cyber police" caller says your SIM will be blocked in two hours unless you pay a fee and share a code. What do you do?

options.text: Hang up. Call your phone company yourself, and report the number

quick_check.explain: A threat plus a fee plus a code is a scam. Your phone company tells the truth.

hints.nudge: What do they want from you besides the SIM?

rows.k: Does anyone honest need your OTP?

rows.v: The fraud-reporting service in your country
